forward_shadow_clean.how_to_satisfy: Run the pilot forward on data that did not exist when the rule was measured. A replay over the cleared window does NOT count and is the substitution this item exists to prevent.
forward_shadow_clean.why_bars_are_not_trades: A trade is an observation only when it CLOSES. Counting bars, flags or entries would be the slice-59 substitution — history or activity relabelled as experience — in the smallest form still available to this programme.

templates_are_not_a_checklist_item: templates_present is a fact about the REPOSITORY, deliberately recorded OUTSIDE the checklist. promotion_gate.CHECKLIST_ITEMS does not contain it and the gate never reads it. Adding a form does not make a decision, and an item marked complete because a template exists would be a placeholder mistaken for the thing it stands in for — the same class of error as calling a replay a forward observation.
note_on_ownership: Six of eight items are things a HUMAN does. A gate a process could satisfy on its own is not a gate. The two machine items are re-derived from the live tree by promotion_gate.evaluate_promotion_gate rather than read from this file, so a hand-edited JSON cannot assert them falsely.
note_on_fail_closed: Flipping every bool in this file to true does NOT allow live: the gate requires the checklist AND config.is_live_authorized independently, and the gate can neither write live_authorized nor clear the kill switch. A missing or unreadable file means REFUSE, not 'assume complete'.

evaluated.why_not_repointed: The canonical declaration stays on the slice-59 file. Re-aiming the live gate at a fresher artefact every slice would make the gate's own wiring a moving part, and a gate whose input can be swapped is a gate that can be swapped for a satisfied one.
